_note: ADD-ONS & SCOPE ADJUSTMENT — optional extras. Each add-on has:
`meaning` (what it is, in plain words), `chargedBy` (the unit we charge per),
`priceIndia` / `priceGlobal` (indicative starting ranges) and `examples`.

heading.title: Start lean.
heading.description: Anything beyond your build's inclusions is an add-on. Here is exactly what each one means and how we charge for it.

items.name: Complex animations
items.meaning: Motion that goes beyond simple fades and hover effects: scroll-driven storytelling, 3D elements, Lottie animations and multi-step micro-interactions.
items.examples: Scroll-triggered sequences · 3D with Spline or Three.js · Animated onboarding flows

items.name: Additional screens
items.meaning: A screen is one distinct page or app view with its own layout, like a login page, dashboard or profile. Extra states of the same screen (a popup, an empty state) don't count as new screens.
items.examples: Anything beyond your tier's screen limit

items.name: Extra integrations
items.meaning: Connecting your product to another service beyond what your build includes, such as a payment gateway, maps, SMS or email service, analytics or a CRM.
items.examples: Payments · Maps · SMS and email · Analytics · CRM

items.name: Third-party auth
items.meaning: Letting users sign in with an existing account, such as Google, Apple or GitHub, in addition to email and password.
items.examples: Google sign-in · Apple sign-in · GitHub sign-in

items.name: Multiple roles
items.meaning: Separate types of users with their own permissions and views, like admin, staff and customer. Each role beyond what your tier includes is charged.
items.examples: Admin vs staff vs customer · Role-based screens and permissions

items.name: Advanced API work
items.meaning: Custom backend logic and endpoints beyond standard create, read, update and delete, such as complex business rules, data processing, or wrapping third-party APIs for your app.
items.examples: Custom business logic · Reporting endpoints · Wrapping external APIs

items.label: Scope-based pricing
items.detail: Pricing increases proportionally based on scope and complexity.

items.label: Doesn't fit a tier?

The general FAQ for other pages lives in faq.json.

sideCard.title: Need help choosing?
sideCard.description: Book a free call and we'll come back within 2–3 business days with a plan, pricing and timeline.

items.question: Why is Indian pricing cheaper than international?
items.answer: Because domestic budgets differ. We keep Indian tiers founder-friendly while staying competitive globally.

items.question: Are calls free?
items.answer: Yes, three of them. The first call, where you explain your vision, is free. The second call covers our full plan, pricing and timeline and includes one round of revision, and the third is a free final call to finalise everything. Any additional call is ₹2,000 / $50 per call, because we keep our time for building. That fee is credited against your project if you go ahead.

items.question: What if my project doesn't fit exactly into one tier?
items.answer: No worries, we customize 100%. Your scope defines your tier, not the other way around.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. Monthly retainers are available for bug fixes, new features, backend support, or design refreshes.

items.question: Can I upgrade my tier later?
items.answer: Absolutely. Many clients start at Tier 1 and upgrade once they raise funds or scale.

items.question: How do I know which tier is right for me?
items.answer: Just book a free consultation, and we'll evaluate your idea, budget, and timeline.
